g.text: The Reviewer approved the head commit
Read the issue of the run again
Stop step of #81, stop the review
ask for the merge decision: cumin/status/awaiting-merge-decision,
then cumin-core requests the review of the Issue Owner
then one notification with the pull request
(only the label changes; start the merge does the same
after the approval of a Maintainer)
At every poll, for an issue in cumin/status/merging
Read the issue again: the actor of the label,
the pull request, the reviews, the checks,
the permissions, and the required checks
The conditions of the merge hold?
wait for the permit of the start, then
resolves it in the same session
Wait 5 seconds after an earlier merge of this poll.
and sha = the approved head commit
Merged, a lost answer, a temporary failure,
The next poll reads the pull request again
wait for the permit of the start, then
resolves it in the same session
